verdict.rationale: v0's docs say you can deploy with one click to Vercel infrastructure and go live in seconds [v0-docs-8, v0-docs-32]. Deploying from a project updates a shared production URL, and projects share hosting and domains [v0-docs-29, v0-docs-11]. A community report credits the fast dev-to-deploy cycle for getting an MVP to users quickly [v0-comm-1]. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the one-click publish flow and the resulting live URL, and direct independent hands-on confirmation that publishing takes a single step (the community report is only indirect).
